evidences.evidence_quote: USRP N210 with a SBX daughter-board according to the open source project [23] for capturing the harmonic RF signals.
evidences.evidence_context: We implement RF-Mic using an Impinj Speedway R420 COTS RFID reader to transmit RF signals and a USRP N210 with a SBX daughter-board according to the open source project [23] for capturing the harmonic RF signals.
evidences.reference_entry: F. Mavromatis N. Kargas and A. Bletsas. 2019. USRP reader. [Online]. Available: https://github.com/nkargas/Gen2-UHF-RFID-Reader.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 正文中[23]指向一个开源软件项目（USRP reader），并非目标论文。引用论文在实现部分仅提及使用该开源项目作为硬件工具，没有涉及目标论文的任何能力或方法。属于misattributed引用。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
